Add the Cully VS Code extension beside Agent Chat. Its live dashboard shows session health and the harness, with MCP details and distinct theme-aware colors; Advisor, Scout and extra details stay collapsed until needed. Add advisor suggestions to Agent Chat as editable prompts. Launch Claude Code, Codex or Cursor through `cully run`, and open status, replay, handoff, harness, impact and self-improvement views from the extension.

Download the attached VSIX and install it with `code --install-extension cully-vscode-0.1.0.vsix`.
